title: Three Kinds of DGX System
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Compare three kinds of DGX system in columns, with a drawing of each device in the first row, then select the kind that matches each of six descriptions.

learningObjectives: The learner will compare the three kinds of DGX system by shape, CPU architecture, and GPU memory arrangement, and select the kind that matches each of 6 descriptions, with at least 5 of 6 correct.
prerequisites: The table of three kinds of system in the NVIDIA DGX section of Chapter 5

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison in columns, with detail on request and a column-selection quiz
keyQuestions: Which kind of system needs a model split across GPUs, and why?
Which package build does each kind of system need?
commonMisconceptions: Every DGX is a rack server.
Every DGX has the same processor architecture.
Every DGX GPU has its own memory.
assessmentOpportunities: Select the column that matches each of six descriptions in Quiz Me mode.
